title: Hera Uses Heat to Reveal a Different View of Two Asteroids

sources.name: JAXA / Hera JAPAN
sources.title: First Thermal Imaging of a Binary Asteroid System

sources.name: European Space Agency (ESA)
sources.title: Hera’s first close-up view of Didymos asteroids

sources.name: JAXA / Hera JAPAN
sources.title: Upcoming Observation and Mission Operations Plan for the Hera Spacecraft in the Binary Asteroid Exploration Mission

paragraphs.en: On November 6, 2026, Japan's space agency JAXA
paragraphs.zh: 2026年11月6日，日本宇宙航空研究開發機構JAXA

paragraphs.en: reported the first thermal images
paragraphs.zh: 公布了首批熱影像，

paragraphs.en: of the Didymos and Dimorphos asteroid system.
paragraphs.zh: 拍攝對象是Didymos與Dimorphos組成的小行星系統。

paragraphs.en: The images came from a Japanese instrument
paragraphs.zh: 這些影像來自日本提供的儀器，

paragraphs.en: on Europe's Hera spacecraft,
paragraphs.zh: 搭載於歐洲的Hera太空船上，

paragraphs.en: which reached the system on November 4,
paragraphs.zh: 太空船於11月4日抵達該系統，

paragraphs.en: according to the agency's announcement.
paragraphs.zh: 這是該機構公告所記載的抵達日期。

paragraphs.en: The observations offer a new way
paragraphs.zh: 這些觀測提供了一種新方法，

paragraphs.en: to investigate these small worlds.
paragraphs.zh: 可用來研究這兩個小天體。

paragraphs.en: The instrument, called TIRI, detects heat
paragraphs.zh: 這部名為TIRI的儀器偵測熱，

paragraphs.en: rather than light reflected from the Sun.
paragraphs.zh: 而非從太陽反射而來的光。

paragraphs.en: It captured the images on October 31,
paragraphs.zh: 它於10月31日拍下這批影像，

paragraphs.en: from about 57 kilometres away.
paragraphs.zh: 當時距離約為57公里。

paragraphs.en: This allows researchers to observe areas
paragraphs.zh: 這讓研究人員能觀察某些區域，

paragraphs.en: that a normal visible-light camera cannot easily show,
paragraphs.zh: 那些區域是一般可見光相機不容易呈現的，

paragraphs.en: including surfaces in shadow.
paragraphs.zh: 包括陰影中的表面。

paragraphs.en: However, converting the readings into temperatures requires calibration.
paragraphs.zh: 不過，將讀值換算成溫度需要進行校正。

paragraphs.en: Temperature changes may reveal how quickly
paragraphs.zh: 溫度變化可能揭示

paragraphs.en: surface materials warm up and cool down.
paragraphs.zh: 表面物質升溫與冷卻的速度有多快。

paragraphs.en: This could provide clues about surface texture.
paragraphs.zh: 這可能提供表面質地的線索。

paragraphs.en: Yet the analysis is still in progress.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，分析仍在進行中。

paragraphs.en: Dimorphos appears cooler partly because it lies
paragraphs.zh: Dimorphos看起來較冷，部分原因是它位於

paragraphs.en: in the larger asteroid's shadow.
paragraphs.zh: 較大小行星的陰影中。

paragraphs.en: A cooler image alone therefore does not prove
paragraphs.zh: 因此，單憑影像中較低的溫度，並不能證明

paragraphs.en: that its material is different.
paragraphs.zh: 它的物質有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Repeated observations are valuable
paragraphs.zh: 重複觀測很有價值，

paragraphs.en: because a single reading cannot show
paragraphs.zh: 因為單次讀值無法呈現

paragraphs.en: how a surface responds
paragraphs.zh: 表面如何隨著

paragraphs.en: as its surroundings change.
paragraphs.zh: 周遭環境的改變而反應。

paragraphs.en: Hera's investigation follows NASA's DART mission.
paragraphs.zh: Hera的調查接續美國太空總署的DART任務而來。

paragraphs.en: On September 26, 2022, DART hit Dimorphos
paragraphs.zh: 2022年9月26日，DART撞上Dimorphos，

paragraphs.en: and changed its orbit around Didymos.
paragraphs.zh: 改變了它繞行Didymos的軌道。

paragraphs.en: In a November 5 report,
paragraphs.zh: 在11月5日的報導中，

paragraphs.en: the European Space Agency described Hera's role
paragraphs.zh: 歐洲太空總署說明了Hera的角色，

paragraphs.en: as a detailed investigation of the impact site.
paragraphs.zh: 就是對撞擊地點展開詳細調查。

paragraphs.en: The aim is to improve understanding
paragraphs.zh: 目標是增進人們的理解，

paragraphs.en: of how such collisions could protect Earth
paragraphs.zh: 了解這類撞擊如何能保護地球，

paragraphs.en: if an asteroid threat ever arose.
paragraphs.zh: 以因應未來可能出現的小行星威脅。

paragraphs.en: This is a test of a possible defence method,
paragraphs.zh: 這是在測試一種可能的防禦方法，

paragraphs.en: rather than a warning
paragraphs.zh: 並非警告大家

paragraphs.en: that these particular asteroids are approaching Earth.
paragraphs.zh: 這兩顆特定的小行星正逼近地球。

paragraphs.en: The next stages involve much more
paragraphs.zh: 接下來各階段的工作，遠遠超過

paragraphs.en: than collecting attractive pictures.
paragraphs.zh: 蒐集漂亮照片。

paragraphs.en: In its November 2 operations plan,
paragraphs.zh: JAXA在11月2日的任務操作計畫中，

paragraphs.en: JAXA outlined an initial survey
paragraphs.zh: 概述了初期勘測工作，

paragraphs.en: from roughly 20 to 30 kilometres away.
paragraphs.zh: 距離大約是20至30公里。

paragraphs.en: Researchers plan to study the asteroids' shapes,
paragraphs.zh: 研究人員計畫研究這些小行星的形狀、

paragraphs.en: masses and movements using several instruments.
paragraphs.zh: 質量與運動情形，並運用多種儀器。

paragraphs.en: Combining measurements can help them develop
paragraphs.zh: 結合各種量測，有助於他們建立

paragraphs.en: a fuller picture of the system.
paragraphs.zh: 對這個系統更完整的認識。

paragraphs.en: The planned distances allow the team
paragraphs.zh: 規劃中的距離讓團隊能夠

paragraphs.en: to build a broad survey
paragraphs.zh: 先建立廣泛的勘測資料，

paragraphs.en: before moving closer for more detailed work.
paragraphs.zh: 再更接近目標，進行更詳細的工作。

paragraphs.en: The same plan schedules two small spacecraft,
paragraphs.zh: 同一份計畫安排了兩艘小型太空船，

paragraphs.en: Juventas and Milani, for deployment in January 2027.
paragraphs.zh: Juventas與Milani，預定於2027年1月部署。

paragraphs.en: Juventas is intended to examine internal structure
paragraphs.zh: Juventas的任務目標是檢查內部結構，

paragraphs.en: using radar, while Milani will investigate surface composition.
paragraphs.zh: 運用的是雷達，而Milani將研究表面成分。

paragraphs.en: These are planned activities, not completed findings.
paragraphs.zh: 這些是預定進行的活動，並非已完成的發現。

paragraphs.en: They should add information that photographs alone
paragraphs.zh: 它們應能補充僅靠照片

paragraphs.en: cannot provide.
paragraphs.zh: 無法提供的資訊。

paragraphs.en: The instruments therefore have complementary jobs:
paragraphs.zh: 因此，這些儀器的工作相互補足：

paragraphs.en: one looks beneath the surface,
paragraphs.zh: 一個探查表面之下，

paragraphs.en: while the other examines what is on it.
paragraphs.zh: 另一個檢視表面上的物質。

paragraphs.en: Together, the reports show why space research
paragraphs.zh: 這幾份報導合在一起，說明了太空研究為何

paragraphs.en: requires both advanced technology and careful interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 既需要先進技術，也需要審慎解讀。

paragraphs.en: A heat map, a visible image and a radar measurement
paragraphs.zh: 熱分布圖、可見光影像與雷達量測，

paragraphs.en: answer different questions.
paragraphs.zh: 各自回答不同的問題。

paragraphs.en: Their value grows when scientists compare them
paragraphs.zh: 當科學家將它們互相比較，

paragraphs.en: and explain the limits of each result.
paragraphs.zh: 並解釋每項結果的限制時，其價值便會提高。

paragraphs.en: Hera's early images begin that process;
paragraphs.zh: Hera的初期影像開啟了這個過程；

paragraphs.en: they do not finish the investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 並不代表調查已經完成。

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of the article?

choices.text: To announce that Hera has completed every part of its mission.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。正文最後指出調查尚未完成，第六段也說明部分工作仍屬計畫。

choices.text: To explain how different measurements can help Hera investigate two asteroids.
choices.explanation: 正確。文章從熱影像出發，介紹撞擊調查及不同儀器如何提供互補資訊。

choices.text: To argue that visible images are no longer useful in space research.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第七段指出可見光影像能回答不同的問題，並未否定其價值。

choices.text: To show that surface temperature proves what an asteroid is made of.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段明確提醒，較冷的影像本身不能證明物質不同。

quiz.explanation: 全文介紹Hera如何結合熱影像、可見光與未來的雷達等觀測來理解小行星。主旨是不同量測的互補價值，同時提醒讀者分析與任務仍在進行。

evidence.quote: Combining measurements can help them develop a fuller picture of the system.
A heat map, a visible image and a radar measurement answer different questions.

quiz.question: What can reasonably be inferred from the discussion of the cooler image of Dimorphos?

choices.text: Researchers should consider lighting and shadow before drawing conclusions about its material.
choices.explanation: 正確。正文指出陰影是溫度較低的部分原因，因此不能直接認定材質不同。

choices.text: The image confirms that Dimorphos and Didymos have identical surface materials.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。不能證明物質不同，也不等於已證明兩者相同。

choices.text: A thermal instrument can only observe surfaces lit directly by the Sun.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第二段說明熱儀器也能觀察陰影中的表面。

choices.text: The research team has already finished analysing every temperature measurement.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段明確說明分析仍在進行。

quiz.explanation: Dimorphos較冷可能受到陰影影響。合理推論是解讀溫度時應先考慮觀測環境，而非僅憑影像斷言材質相同或不同。

evidence.quote: Dimorphos appears cooler partly because it lies in the larger asteroid's shadow. A cooler image alone therefore does not prove that its material is different.

quiz.question: Which statement best summarises the status of the mission described in the article?

choices.text: DART will reach Dimorphos after Juventas and Milani complete their work.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。DART撞擊發生於2022年，而兩艘小型太空船的部署規劃在2027年。

choices.text: All three spacecraft have already produced final results about internal structure.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。Juventas與Milani仍是預定部署，沒有已完成的內部結構研究結論。

choices.text: Hera has obtained early images, while further investigations remain planned.
choices.explanation: 正確。第一段介紹已取得的熱影像，第六段區分未來活動與完成的發現。

choices.text: The mission is limited to taking photographs of the impact site.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五、六段介紹形狀、質量、運動、內部結構與成分等研究目標。

quiz.explanation: 文章區分已發生的成果與未來計畫：初期熱影像已公布，更多勘測及小型太空船任務仍待執行，不能將預定研究當成既有成果。

evidence.quote: On November 6, 2026, Japan's space agency JAXA reported the first thermal images of the Didymos and Dimorphos asteroid system.
These are planned activities, not completed findings.
